title: agentic-footprint derived records (Contract #2 — informative in v0.1)
description: Control-plane outputs. This contract is informative in v0.1; it will be made normative in a later RFC aligned with GSF SCI / OTel GenAI semantic conventions.

range.description: Uncertainty range. min == max expresses a point value.

criterion.description: One impact criterion with usage/embodied life-cycle split when the methodology provides it.

unit.description: e.g. kWh, kgCO2eq, kgSbeq, MJ, L

impact_estimate.description: Estimated impacts of one llm_call event (remote inference).

event_id.description: The llm_call event this estimate derives from.

estimation_status.description: Failure honesty: an unestimable call is surfaced, never skipped or zeroed. `missing_usage` is a call whose llm_call carried no token count — it never reaches the estimator, and reporting it as `error` or `pending` would attribute the gap to the estimator rather than to the collector that could not observe the usage.

version.description: Version of the methodology data artifact used.

impact_join.description: Joined local-measured + remote-estimated impacts for one attribution unit over an interval. The combined total crosses measurement paradigms (measured + modeled) and MUST be presented as such.

attribution_policy.description: Policy used to apportion machine energy to this unit. Recorded so results are interpretable and re-computable.

baseline_share_excluded.description: True when idle/baseline energy was separated out rather than attributed to actions.

coverage.description: Fraction of the unit's wall time covered by energy samples.

combined_total.description: Sum of local measured + remote estimated per criterion, ranges preserved. Cross-paradigm: label accordingly in presentation.

unmeasured_remote_spans.description: Count of execution_locus=remote action spans excluded from the local join and not (yet) estimable.
